claims.explanation: TW-37 is a BH3 mimetic that directly inhibits the anti-apoptotic BCL-2 family proteins BCL2, BCL2L1 (BCL-XL), and MCL1, thereby releasing pro-apoptotic effectors to trigger apoptosis. Cancer cell lines that depend on these anti-apoptotic proteins for survival—due to high expression of BCL2, BCL2L1, or MCL1, or loss of apoptotic effectors like BAX—are expected to be selectively killed. Conversely, intact apoptotic signaling (e.g., wild-type TP53, high BAX/BAK) and low dependence on BCL-2 proteins confer resistance.

NOXA neutralizes MCL1, enhancing sensitivity to BCL-2 inhibition
